sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: β-arrestin2 recruitment BRET assay (L1/L2): receptor was expressed and functional at the cell surface. Gi activation ebBRET assay (L6): HiBiT-GPR183 used to screen compounds for constitutive activity inhibition, confirming functional surface expression.
sites.rationale: GPR183 is a GPCR with no endogenous signal peptide; residues 1–31 are extracellular per topology landmarks, making the N-terminus the only extracellular terminus. The paper (L2) explicitly describes a full-length construct with an exogenous cleavable signal sequence followed by a FLAG tag, placing the tag at the mature N-terminus (before residue 1, i.e., insert_after_residue=0). L1 confirms functional use in β-arrestin2 BRET assays, and L6 independently confirms N-terminal HiBiT tagging with Gi functional readout. Position 0 is ≥3 residues from TM1 (which begins at residue 32). Full-length human GPR183 expressed in HEK293 cells with an exogenous cleavable signal sequence (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA) followed by an N-terminal FLAG (M1) tag immediately before GPR183 residue 1; GPR183 has no endogenous signal peptide (topology begins extracellular at residue 1), so the FLAG tag is presented at the mature N-terminus after signal-peptide cleavage. The same construct architecture is independently confirmed by HiBiT-GPR183 (L6), which also places a small tag at the N-terminus.

sources.claim: Human or mouse GPR183 cDNAs were inserted into the pcDNA3.1 + vector with an upstream hemagglutinin cleavable signal sequence MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA and an N-terminal FLAG tag.

literature_notes: L3, L4, and L5 report mNeonGreen insertions after residues named P231, T233, and K235 in the paper (PMC13392048). Searching the canonical sequence for the P…T…K pattern with 2-residue spacing in the ICL3 region identifies these as canonical P232, T234, and K236 (paper numbering is offset by +1 relative to UniProt canonical). All three positions fall within ICL3 (topology landmarks 218–244, INTRACELLULAR). They are therefore not extracellular surface tag sites and are recorded in other_positions. L6 describes a HiBiT-GPR183 construct used in a Gi BRET assay; the HiBiT tag is at the N-terminus (consistent with L1/L2) and does not constitute a separate site. No ledger line supports any insertion in ECL1 (90–101), ECL2 (169–192), or ECL3 (267–289).
